Name: Zechariah, Father of Abijah
Summary: Zechariah was the father of Abijah, mother of King Hezekiah; 2 Chronicles does not state whether he is Zechariah who instructed Uzziah.
KeyStory: Zechariah is named only as the father of Abijah, Hezekiah's mother.
LifeLesson: A mother's father links two reigns in a single line.
